summary: The AI landscape is rapidly evolving, with significant breakthroughs in research papers, new model releases, and industry-shaping product launches. Top universities and labs, such as Carnegie Mellon and Stanford, are advancing AI-driven initiatives, while companies like Netflix, DoorDash, and Uber are integrating AI into their platforms. Meanwhile, Meta AI and OpenAI are focusing on practical adoption and enterprise applications.

highlights.title: 7700+ Latest ArXiv AI/ML Research Papers 2025–2026
highlights.insight: This dataset captures 7,701 peer-reviewed and preprint research papers submitted to arXiv.org between September 2025 and April 2026, showcasing the rapid proliferation of large language models.

highlights.title: LLM Research Papers: The 2026 List (January to May)
highlights.insight: The list highlights recent research papers on hybrid architectures, state space layers, and representation geometry, demonstrating the ongoing advancements in large language models.

highlights.title: Machine Learning - Netflix Research
highlights.insight: Netflix is integrating AI and machine learning into its platform, focusing on artwork personalization via LLM post-training and other applications.

highlights.title: How we built our AI/ML Platform at DoorDash
highlights.insight: DoorDash is betting on AI, autonomy, and global growth, with a focus on building a scalable AI/ML platform to support its operations.

highlights.title: Carnegie Mellon Launches New Effort to Advance AI-Driven Astronomy
highlights.insight: Carnegie Mellon is launching a new initiative to advance AI-driven astronomy, supported by the Simons Foundation, aiming to accelerate breakthroughs at the intersection of AI and astrophysics.

highlights.title: Hugging Face new models, June 2026
highlights.insight: Hugging Face has released new models in June 2026, with a focus on Transformers and other AI architectures, expanding its library of pre-trained models.

highlights.title: OpenAI to focus on 'practical adoption' in 2026
highlights.insight: OpenAI is shifting its focus to practical adoption in 2026, with a emphasis on driving monetization of its services and securing compute infrastructure.

highlights.title: The 2026 AI Index Report
highlights.insight: The 2026 AI Index Report provides a comprehensive overview of the AI landscape, highlighting key trends, challenges, and opportunities in the field.

highlights.title: Uber’s finance team overtaken by engineering in AI use
highlights.insight: Uber's finance team is being overtaken by engineering in AI use, with the company's rapid adoption of agentic AI coding tools consuming its 2026 AI budget and raising return-on-investment questions.

highlights.title: Meta's AI Roadmap for 2026
highlights.insight: Meta AI has announced its roadmap for 2026, focusing on empowering personal superintelligence and driving AI adoption across various industries.

highlights.title: INSAIT and MIT CSAIL Joint Research Program
highlights.insight: MIT CSAIL has established a joint research program with INSAIT, aiming to promote academic development and high-impact research in AI and computer science.
